correctness.rationale: All 766 simplicial faces were generated independently by squared-line-graph conflict recursion and direct induced-endpoint tests; every six-edge choice was excluded. The completely specified 324-pair matching leaves one 0-cell and 116 2-cells. The full 2,214-incidence directed Hasse graph on 765 nonempty faces is acyclic by exhaustive topological sorting, so Forman theory proves the integral wedge homotopy type, not merely a field calculation. Backtracking exhausts all 216 graph automorphisms; signed reduced fixed-face Lefschetz traces yield the character histogram and zero invariant multiplicity. Verification source and exact reproduced output are embedded.

value.rationale: Induced edge matchings are a long-studied graph packing notion; the complex of all such matchings is a canonical topological refinement. The 18-vertex cubic symmetric Pappus incidence graph is a natural high-symmetry test case. A nonpure dimension-4 complex that is integrally a wedge of 116 2-spheres, paired with the full automorphism character and its vanishing trivial constituent, provides nonroutine homotopy and symmetry data not deducible from the induced-matching number or any identified ordinary matching calculation. No arbitrary slice or unsupported generalization is claimed.
